'''2017 MPC Keith Brown LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Keith Brown]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Player:''' [[Keith Brown]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
